messages: i loved watching new girl with you. i get really happy when you're happy
i love the care and love you have for junebug
i love your comedic timing when answering serious questions with silly noises
i love the patience you demonstrate when we cook together
i love the attention with which you listen when i'm telling you about all the mundane things i've been up to all day
i loved watching you interact with big johns - what a dynamic duo
i love your willingness to accept all of my many peculiarities
i love your arts and crafts - i think they're all so well done and so cute
i love your wit and your ability to make me laugh
i love your bravery and your persistence
i love your love for your friends - watching you all interact in your suite made me so happy
